summary.text: Call CPF or visit a CPF Service Centre. Your request takes around three to five working days to process after your identity is verified.

details.heading: How long it takes
details.body: Your request takes around three to five working days to process after CPF successfully verifies your identity.

steps.name: Choose how to contact CPF
steps.text: Call the CPF hotline during operating hours and select option 8 after choosing your language. Or make an appointment to visit any CPF Service Centre during operating hours.

items: Call 1800-227-1188 during operating hours. Choose your language, then select option 8. If you are calling from overseas, call +65-6227-1188.
Make an appointment to visit any CPF Service Centre during operating hours.

quotes.text: Note that your deactivation request will take around three to five working days to process, after we successfully verify your identity.
